test_test_ipynb: test the test_ipynb runner that loads and executes vizseq ipynb test suites
run_view_stats_core: run view_stats from vizseq.ipynb.core with source and references to display statistics
run_view_examples_core: run view_examples from vizseq.ipynb.core with source references and hypothesis to display examples
run_view_scores_core: run view_scores from vizseq.ipynb.core with references hypothesis and metric names to display scores
run_view_n_grams_core: run view_n_grams from vizseq.ipynb.core with references to display n-grams
run_view_stats_fairseq: run view_stats from vizseq.ipynb.fairseq_viz with log paths to display fairseq statistics
run_view_examples_fairseq: run view_examples from vizseq.ipynb.fairseq_viz with log paths to display fairseq examples
run_view_scores_fairseq: run view_scores from vizseq.ipynb.fairseq_viz with log paths and metric names to display fairseq scores
run_view_n_grams_fairseq: run view_n_grams from vizseq.ipynb.fairseq_viz with log paths to display fairseq n-grams
